Democrats Are Gearing Up to Investigate the Trump Administration. It Won’t Be Easy. As a recent government report on DOGE shows, even getting basic information out of the Trump administration will put a new Congress to the test.

Artemis III Scientist Shares What to Expect From NASA’s Next Lunar Mission. Though scaled back from initial plans of landing, the voyage will serve as a dress rehearsal for when humans return to the moon’s surface.

Over $600 Million in Polymarket Election Trades Took Place After Races Ended. Contracts tied to elections in Ethiopia and Romania saw massive trading volumes after the outcomes were decided. “It’s obviously some form of volume manipulation,” one expert says.

Jerry Seinfeld turns tables on radical anti-Israel agitators after chaotic Chicago stunt backfires. Viral video shows Jerry Seinfeld dancing and mocking anti-Israel hecklers at the Chicago Theatre as security escorted protesters from the venue.

Brewers officially end Dodgers dynasty with ridiculous 6-4 comeback in game four to complete NLCS sweep. Shohei Ohtani's 428-foot three-run homer gave the Dodgers a 4-0 lead, but the Brewers' unlikely heroes erased it all to complete an NLCS sweep.

FBI returns 'Most Wanted' fraudster to US after India arrest in alleged $600K SNAP food stamp scheme. FBI Director Kash Patel announced Manjit Singh Bedi, accused of stealing over $600,000 in SNAP benefits in Tacoma, has been returned from India.

Less than 2 years after coaching college hoops in Florida, Karl Smesko leads Atlanta Dream to WNBA Finals. Karl Smesko left Florida Gulf Coast's beach campus after eight 30-win seasons to chase the title he could never win there with the Atlanta Dream.

Katie Zacharia addresses brevity of first press briefing, defends legal credentials after criticism. Katie Zacharia defended her debut White House press briefing and addressed California bar exam scrutiny during interview with Sean Hannity.

Trans neo-Nazi accused of plotting Hindu temple massacre, will receive hormone treatment in jail: officials. A transgender 19-year-old alleged neo-Nazi plotted an attack on a Hindu temple, but the firearm malfunctioned and a coworker's tip led to an arrest.

21-year-old football player dead after head injury sustained during Division II college game. Division II football player Tyler Ulrich, 21, suffered a head injury during a Southern Nazarene University game Saturday that proved fatal five days later.

'Oh, shut up!': Democrat snaps at Collins after heckler drives Maine Senate debate off the rails. A protester yelling about AI data centers sparked a fiery clash between Republican Sen. Susan Collins and Democratic challenger Troy Jackson.

Hasan Piker defends using incendiary terms like 'inbred' or 'Zionist pig' against opponents. Hasan Piker defended calling Zionist opponents "inbred" and "Zionist pig" in an NPR interview Thursday, saying the language targeted ideology, not background.

Bears QB Caleb Williams shuts down reporters asking about his hamstring injury: 'It's not deserving'. Chicago Bears QB Caleb Williams returned to full practice but refused to reveal his hamstring tear grade, calling national reports about his diagnosis wrong.

Experimental skin cream linked to 2-year drop in biological age in early study. Rubedo Life Sciences says its skin cream RLS-1496 cleared senescent cells, boosted collagen 10% and reduced skin age in a four-week trial study.

Kash Patel demands MS NOW apologize after network's false report claiming FBI director visited Russia. FBI Director Kash Patel is demanding an apology from MS NOW after the network falsely claimed he "landed in Russia" for meetings, which was debunked.

Can cooking for terrorists bar asylum? Supreme Court takes up unusual case with broader immigration stakes. A Nigerian man forced to cook for the Unknown Gunmen terrorist group is now at the center of a Supreme Court battle over asylum and material support.

Knicks fan recreates OG Anunoby's signature Game 4 tip-in with skeletons in iconic Halloween setup. A New Jersey home recreated OG Anunoby's iconic New York Knicks tip-in against the San Antonio Spurs using skeletons and a 12-foot Wemby skeleton.

Made in California business directory lets buyers filter by identity but excludes White men. The state-run Made in California business directory sparked backlash by excluding White and male as owner identity categories on the website.

Hit a midlife wall? This test identifies your strengths and what matters to you. As part of her new podcast and newsletter Your Turn with Allison Aubrey, NPR's Allison Aubrey went in search of tools to help navigate midlife — starting with this survey to rank one's character strengths.

Suspicious mailings to election officials, congressional offices under investigation. The FBI and U.S. Postal Inspection Service are looking into the mailings, some of which included an unidentified powdery white substance.

U.S. historic preservation law faces the most serious threat in its 60-year history. Congress and a federal agency are threatening to weaken the country's historic preservation law, fueling a backlash that critics say is as fiery as the one that led to the law's creation 60 years ago.

Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space. The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.

Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric. Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

After booting 760K off ACA health plans, the Trump administration adds some people back. The Trump administration provided few details about its process for canceling hundreds of thousands of Affordable Care Act enrollments — even as the next stage of the anti-fraud effort is underway.

Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce. Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.

Greetings from Mexico City, where a bullfighting ban doesn't stop this matador training. One plays the bull, the other the bullfighter, as a pair practices a dance of death in a sport that's prohibited in the Mexican capital city.

Make a 'sick day' kit for cold and flu season before your household gets hit. Cold and flu season is here. Before someone in your household gets hit, make sure you have these essential meds and comfort items in your medicine cabinet.

These swing voters regret voting for Trump and it's influencing their midterm choices. Some key voters in Georgia say deep frustration and disappointment with President Trump are motivating their election plans just weeks before Election Day.
